verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בָּבֶ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אָמֽוֹץ׃ חָזָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: maś·śā bā·ḇel ’ă·šer yə·ša‘·yā·hū ben- ’ā·mō·wṣ ḥā·zāh
verses.literal: [This is] the burden against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz received

verses.original: שְֽׂאוּ־ נֵ֔ס עַ֤ל נִשְׁפֶּה֙ הַר־ הָרִ֥ימוּ ק֖וֹל לָהֶ֑ם הָנִ֣יפוּ יָ֔ד וְיָבֹ֖אוּ פִּתְחֵ֥י נְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- nês ‘al niš·peh har- hā·rî·mū qō·wl lā·hem hā·nî·p̄ū yāḏ wə·yā·ḇō·’ū piṯ·ḥê nə·ḏî·ḇîm
verses.literal: Raise a banner on a barren hilltop call aloud to them Wave your hand that they may enter the gates of the nobles

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י צִוֵּ֖יתִי לִמְקֻדָּשָׁ֑י גַּ֣ם קָרָ֤אתִי גִבּוֹרַי֙ לְאַפִּ֔י עַלִּיזֵ֖י גַּאֲוָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ṣiw·wê·ṯî lim·qud·dā·šāy gam qā·rā·ṯî ḡib·bō·w·ray lə·’ap·pî ‘al·lî·zê ga·’ă·wā·ṯî
verses.literal: I have commanded My sanctified ones I have even summoned My warriors to execute My wrath [and] exult in My triumph

verses.original: ק֥וֹל הָמ֛וֹן בֶּֽהָרִ֖ים דְּמ֣וּת רָ֑ב עַם־ ק֠וֹל שְׁא֞וֹן מַמְלְכ֤וֹת גּוֹיִם֙ נֶֽאֱסָפִ֔ים יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְפַקֵּ֖ד צְבָ֥א מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl hā·mō·wn be·hā·rîm də·mūṯ rāḇ ‘am- qō·wl šə·’ō·wn mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ gō·w·yim ne·’ĕ·sā·p̄îm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mə·p̄aq·qêḏ ṣə·ḇā mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Listen a tumult on the mountains like that of a great multitude Listen an uproar among the kingdoms like nations gathered together The LORD of Hosts is mobilizing an army for war

verses.original: בָּאִ֛ים מֶרְחָ֖ק מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִקְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם יְהוָה֙ וּכְלֵ֣י זַעְמ֔וֹ לְחַבֵּ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·’îm mer·ḥāq mê·’e·reṣ miq·ṣêh haš·šā·mā·yim Yah·weh ū·ḵə·lê za‘·mōw lə·ḥab·bêl kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: They are coming from faraway lands from the ends of the heavens the LORD and the weapons of His wrath to destroy the whole country

verses.original: הֵילִ֕ילוּ כִּ֥י י֣וֹם יְהוָ֑ה קָר֖וֹב יָבֽוֹא׃ כְּשֹׁ֖ד מִשַּׁדַּ֥י
verses.transliteration: hê·lî·lū kî yō·wm Yah·weh qā·rō·wḇ yā·ḇō·w kə·šōḏ miš·šad·day
verses.literal: Wail for the Day of the LORD is near it will come as destruction from the Almighty

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֖ן כָּל־ יָדַ֣יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְכָל־ אֱנ֖וֹשׁ לְבַ֥ב יִמָּס׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên kāl- yā·ḏa·yim tir·pe·nāh wə·ḵāl ’ĕ·nō·wōš lə·ḇaḇ yim·må̄s
verses.literal: Therefore . . . all hands will fall limp and every man’s heart will melt

verses.original: וְֽנִבְהָ֓לוּ׀ צִירִ֤ים וַֽחֲבָלִים֙ יֹֽאחֵז֔וּן יְחִיל֑וּן כַּיּוֹלֵדָ֖ה אֶל־ אִ֤ישׁ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ פְּנֵ֥י לְהָבִ֖ים פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃ יִתְמָ֔הוּ
verses.transliteration: wə·niḇ·hā·lū ṣî·rîm wa·ḥă·ḇā·lîm yō·ḥê·zūn yə·ḥî·lūn kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh ’el- ’îš rê·‘ê·hū pə·nê lə·hā·ḇîm pə·nê·hem yiṯ·mā·hū
verses.literal: Terror pain and anguish will seize them they will writhe like a woman in labor They will look at one another their faces flushed . . . with fear

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יוֹם־ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔א אַכְזָרִ֥י וְעֶבְרָ֖ה וַחֲר֣וֹן אָ֑ף לָשׂ֤וּם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה יַשְׁמִ֥יד וְחַטָּאֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yō·wm- Yah·weh bā ’aḵ·zā·rî wə·‘eḇ·rāh wa·ḥă·rō·wn ’āp̄ lā·śūm hā·’ā·reṣ lə·šam·māh yaš·mîḏ wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’e·hā mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: Behold the Day of the LORD is coming cruel with fury and burning anger . . . to make the earth a desolation and to destroy the sinners within it

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כוֹכְבֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּכְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יָהֵ֖לּוּ אוֹרָ֑ם בְּצֵאת֔וֹ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ חָשַׁ֤ךְ וְיָרֵ֖חַ לֹֽא־ יַגִּ֥יהַ אוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḵə·sî·lê·hem lō yā·hêl·lū ’ō·w·rām bə·ṣê·ṯōw haš·še·meš ḥā·šaḵ wə·yā·rê·aḥ lō- yag·gî·ha ’ō·w·rōw
verses.literal: For the stars of heaven and their constellations will not give their light The rising sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֤י עַל־ תֵּבֵל֙ רָעָ֔ה וְעַל־ רְשָׁעִ֖ים עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן זֵדִ֔ים אַשְׁפִּֽיל׃ וְגַאֲוַ֥ת עָרִיצִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- tê·ḇêl rā·‘āh wə·‘al- rə·šā·‘îm ‘ă·wō·nām wə·hiš·bat·tî gə·’ō·wn zê·ḏîm ’aš·pîl wə·ḡa·’ă·waṯ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm
verses.literal: I will punish - the world [for its] evil and the wicked for their iniquity I will end the haughtiness of the arrogant and lay low the pride of the ruthless

verses.original: אֱנ֖וֹשׁ אוֹקִ֥יר מִפָּ֑ז וְאָדָ֖ם מִכֶּ֥תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·nō·wōš ’ō·w·qîr mip·pāz wə·’ā·ḏām mik·ke·ṯem ’ō·w·p̄îr
verses.literal: {I will make} man scarcer than pure gold and mankind rarer than the gold of Ophir

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם אַרְגִּ֔יז הָאָ֖רֶץ וְתִרְעַ֥שׁ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ בְּעֶבְרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבְי֖וֹם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên šā·ma·yim ’ar·gîz hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ṯir·‘aš mim·mə·qō·w·māh bə·‘eḇ·raṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ū·ḇə·yō·wm ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I will make the heavens tremble and the earth will be shaken from its place at the wrath of the LORD of Hosts on the day of His burning anger . . .

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ מֻדָּ֔ח כִּצְבִ֣י וּכְצֹ֖אן וְאֵ֣ין מְקַבֵּ֑ץ אִ֤ישׁ יִפְנ֔וּ אֶל־ עַמּוֹ֙ וְאִ֥ישׁ יָנֽוּסוּ׃ אֶל־ אַרְצ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh mud·dāḥ kiṣ·ḇî ū·ḵə·ṣōn wə·’ên mə·qab·bêṣ ’îš yip̄·nū ’el- ‘am·mōw wə·’îš yā·nū·sū ’el- ’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: - Like a hunted gazelle like a sheep without a shepherd each will return to his own people each will flee to his native land

verses.original: כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֖א יִדָּקֵ֑ר וְכָל־ הַנִּסְפֶּ֖ה יִפּ֥וֹל בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- han·nim·ṣā yid·dā·qêr wə·ḵāl han·nis·peh yip·pō·wl be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever is caught will be stabbed and whoever is captured will die by the sword

verses.original: וְעֹלְלֵיהֶ֥ם יְרֻטְּשׁ֖וּ לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם בָּֽתֵּיהֶ֔ם יִשַּׁ֙סּוּ֙ וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם תִּשָּׁגַלְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·lə·lê·hem yə·ruṭ·ṭə·šū lə·‘ê·nê·hem bāt·tê·hem yiš·šas·sū ū·nə·šê·hem tiš·šå̄·ḡal·nå̄h
verses.literal: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes their houses will be looted and their wives will be ravished

verses.original: הִנְנִ֛י מֵעִ֥יר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מָדָ֑י אֶת־ אֲשֶׁר־ לֹ֣א יַחְשֹׁ֔בוּ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ־ בֽוֹ׃ וְזָהָ֖ב
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mê·‘îr ‘ă·lê·hem mā·ḏāy ’eṯ- ’ă·šer- lō yaḥ·šō·ḇū ke·sep̄ lō yaḥ·pə·ṣū- ḇōw wə·zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: Behold I will stir up against them the Medes - who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold

verses.original: וּקְשָׁת֖וֹת נְעָרִ֣ים תְּרַטַּ֑שְׁנָה לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ וּפְרִי־ בֶ֙טֶן֙ לֹֽא־ תָח֥וּס עֵינָֽם׃ עַל־ בָּנִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ū·qə·šā·ṯō·wṯ nə·‘ā·rîm tə·raṭ·ṭaš·nāh lō yə·ra·ḥê·mū ū·p̄ə·rî- ḇe·ṭen lō- ṯā·ḥūs ‘ê·nām ‘al- bā·nîm
verses.literal: Their bows {will dash} young men to pieces they will have no mercy on the fruit of the womb they will not look with pity . . . on the children

verses.original: בָבֶל֙ צְבִ֣י מַמְלָכ֔וֹת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּא֣וֹן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וְהָיְתָ֤ה כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ סְדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־ עֲמֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·ḇel ṣə·ḇî mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ tip̄·’e·reṯ gə·’ō·wn kaś·dîm wə·hā·yə·ṯāh kə·mah·pê·ḵaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- sə·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·mō·rāh
verses.literal: And Babylon the jewel of the kingdoms the glory of the pride of the Chaldeans will be overthrown by God - like Sodom - and Gomorrah

verses.original: לֹֽא־ לָנֶ֔צַח תֵשֵׁ֣ב וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁכֹּ֖ן עַד־ דּ֣וֹר וָד֑וֹר וְלֹֽא־ עֲרָבִ֔י יַהֵ֥ל שָׁם֙ לֹא־ וְרֹעִ֖ים יַרְבִּ֥צוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- lā·ne·ṣaḥ ṯê·šêḇ wə·lō ṯiš·kōn ‘aḏ- dō·wr wā·ḏō·wr wə·lō- ‘ă·rā·ḇî ya·hêl šām lō- wə·rō·‘îm yar·bi·ṣū šām
verses.literal: She will never . . . be inhabited or settled from generation to generation no nomad will pitch his tent there no shepherd will rest his flock there

verses.original: צִיִּ֔ים וְרָבְצוּ־ שָׁ֣ם אֹחִ֑ים וּמָלְא֥וּ בָתֵּיהֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֔ה וְשָׁ֤כְנוּ שָׁם֙ וּשְׂעִירִ֖ים יְרַקְּדוּ־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yîm wə·rā·ḇə·ṣū- šām ’ō·ḥîm ū·mā·lə·’ū ḇāt·tê·hem bə·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh wə·šā·ḵə·nū šām ū·śə·‘î·rîm yə·raq·qə·ḏū- šām
verses.literal: But desert creatures will lie down there and howling creatures will fill her houses vvv Ostriches will dwell there and wild goats will leap about . . .

verses.original: אִיִּים֙ וְעָנָ֤ה בְּאַלְמנוֹתָ֔יו וְתַנִּ֖ים עֹ֑נֶג בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי עִתָּ֔הּ וְקָר֤וֹב לָבוֹא֙ וְיָמֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א יִמָּשֵֽׁכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yîm wə·‘ā·nāh bə·ʾal·m·nō·ṯå̄w wə·ṯan·nîm ‘ō·neḡ bə·hê·ḵə·lê ‘it·tāh wə·qā·rō·wḇ lā·ḇō·w wə·yā·me·hā lō yim·mā·šê·ḵū
verses.literal: Hyenas will howl in her fortresses and jackals in her luxurious palaces [Babylon’s] time is at hand . . . and her days will not be prolonged
